title: Extension of a chain complex to a nonpositive cochain complex
statement: Let $C$ be a category with zero morphisms (every $\mathrm{Hom}(Y,Z)$ has a distinguished element $0$ with $g\circ0=0$ and $0\circ f=0$) and a zero object, and let $K$ be a chain complex in $C$ indexed by $\mathbb N$, with differentials $d_{n+1,n}:K_{n+1}\to K_n$. Its extension along $n\mapsto-n$ (Mathlib's `K.extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat`) is a cochain complex $E$ indexed by $\mathbb Z$ such that: (i) for $n\in\mathbb N$ there is a canonical isomorphism $E^{-n}\cong K_n$, under which the differential $E^{-n-1}\to E^{-n}$ is $d_{n+1,n}$; (ii) $E^q$ is a zero object for every $q>0$, i.e. $E$ is strictly supported in degrees $\le0$; (iii) for $n\in\mathbb N$, $E$ is exact at $-n$ if and only if $K$ is exact at $n$; (iv) the extension is a functor from $\mathbb N$-indexed chain complexes to $\mathbb Z$-indexed cochain complexes, sending a chain map $\varphi$ to the map that is $\varphi_n$ in degree $-n$ (under (i)) and $0$ in positive degrees.

mathlib_searches.query: The extension of a chain complex along embeddingDownNat is strictly supported in degrees at most zero
extending a chain complex by zero along the negative natural embedding yields a strictly nonpositive cochain complex
